BMI_Clinical_Note: BMI 25–29.9 — Indian Obese Class I. Significant metabolic & BC recurrence risk. Mediterranean diet + exercise.
Waist_Risk_Indian: Central Obesity (≥80 cm — Indian Women Threshold)
Hormone_Therapy: No Hormone Therapy (TNBC — ER-, PR-, HER2-)
Bone_Density_Concern: LOW-MODERATE — Routine monitoring. Adequate dietary calcium (dairy/ragi/sesame) + exercise.
Nutrition_Impact_Symptoms: Anorexia/Poor Appetite; Fatigue; Mucositis/Oral Sores; Nausea; Peripheral Neuropathy; Weight Loss
Vitamin_D_IU_per_day: 400 IU/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) — sunlight 15–20 min/day also essential
Calcium_mg_per_day: 600 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) — dietary calcium from dairy/ragi/sesame preferred
Zinc_mg_per_day: 10 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — important for immune function + wound healing
Dietary_Fibre_g_per_day: 40 g/day (ICMR-NIN 2020); reduce to 25 g if diarrhoea/mucositis
Omega3_Recommendation: 2–3 g EPA/DHA/day — fish oil supplement [ESPEN B5-7]
Protein_Source_Note: Protein: eggs (2/day) + dal + paneer + curd + legumes + soya
Alcohol_Guidance: ZERO alcohol — carcinogen; increases BC recurrence risk [ESPEN C5-2]
ICMR_NIN_2020_Reference: ICMR-NIN Nutrient Requirements & RDA for Indians (2020 revision)
Nutrition_Route_ESPEN: Individualized dietary counselling + ONS → EN if goals not met [ESPEN B3-1]
Supplement_Recommendation: ONS 1–2x/day: Pentasure HP / Ensure Plus / Fresubin Energy / Disprolene (Indian brands preferred); Omega-3 / EPA 2–3 g/day (fish oil) [ESPEN B5-7] — lean mass + neuropathy protection; Calcium 600 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) + Vitamin D 400 IU/day + 15–20 min daily sunlight; Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — monitor Hb; IV iron if <8 g/dL on chemo; Folate 220–400 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020; higher during chemo); Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignans — phytoestrogen modulation; beneficial ER+ Indian BC survivors); Megestrol Acetate / short-term Corticosteroid — physician-prescribed [ESPEN B5-1/B5-2] (note DVT risk with megestrol in Indian patients); Multivitamin/mineral at RDA dose ONLY (ICMR-NIN 2020). NOT high-dose. Avoid selenium, Vit E, Vit C megadoses during chemo.
Exercise_Plan_ESPEN_India: Aerobic: Brisk walk 45 min/day OR 150–300 min/week (cycling, swimming, Zumba, yoga) [ESPEN B4-1/C5-1]; Resistance: 2–3x/week, 8–12 reps, major muscle groups; can use resistance bands/body weight at home [ESPEN B4-2]; Yoga: 3–5x/week (Suryanamaskar, Pranayama, Shavasana) — evidence for fatigue reduction + cortisol in Indian BC survivors; TARGET: 150–300 min/week moderate activity — reduces Indian BC recurrence risk and improves overall survival
ESPEN_Guidelines_India: 📋 SCREENING [B1-1]: Regular nutritional assessment from diagnosis. Indian BC patients — ICMR/WHO Asian BMI cut-offs apply (Normal: 18.5–22.9; Overweight: ≥23; Obese: ≥25). [East India (West Bengal/Odisha/Bihar/Jharkhand)] | 📋 ASSESSMENT [B1-2]: PG-SGA score elevated → quantitative assessment: 24-hr dietary recall, muscle mass (BIA/DEXA/mid-arm circumference), grip strength, CRP/albumin, NIS. | ⚡ ENERGY [B2-1]: 25–30 kcal/kg/day (ESPEN). Indian context: average Indian BC woman body weight 55–65 kg. Total: 1400–2000 kcal/day depending on stage and activity. | 🥩 PROTEIN [B2-2]: >1 g/kg/day (ESPEN); ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA: 0.83 g/kg/day (healthy); BC treatment: 1.0–1.5 g/kg/day. Vegetarian patients: dal+rice+dairy combination essential for complete amino acid profile. | 💊 MICRONUTRIENTS [B2-4 + ICMR-NIN 2020]: Vitamin D (endemic deficiency in India — 400–1000 IU/day), Calcium (600–1200 mg/day from ragi/dairy/sesame), Iron (19–29 mg/day), Folate (220–400 mcg/day). AVOID high-dose antioxidants during chemo. | ⚠ INDIAN OBESITY [Obese Class I]: Indian BMI ≥25 = Obese. Metabolic syndrome highly prevalent. Obesity is independent risk factor for BC recurrence and mortality in Indian women. Weight management essential post-treatment. | 🥗 NUTRITION [B3-1]: Active nutritional counselling + ONS if enriched Indian diet insufficient. | ⚠ INTERVENTION [B3-2]: No energy restriction during treatment. No unproven diets — ketogenic, prolonged fasting, 'cancer-curing' diets widely promoted on Indian social media are NOT evidence-based. | 💉 CHEMO [C3-1/C3-2]: Maintain intake during all cycles. Common Indian patient challenge: nausea reducing dal/sabzi intake. Small frequent meals; ginger/ajwain/saunf for nausea. ONS if <75% intake. | 🐟 OMEGA-3 [B5-7]: 2–3 g EPA/day (fish oil or algae-based for vegetarians) — reduces chemo toxicity, preserves lean mass, protective against neuropathy. | ❌ [C3-3]: No glutamine. No high-dose antioxidants during chemotherapy. | 🔴 TNBC [Indian]: High incidence in young premenopausal Indian women. Aggressive chemo → highest nutritional risk. Protein priority 1.5–2.0 g/kg/day. Anti-inflammatory diet. Immunotherapy GI AE management. | 💊 APPETITE [B5-1/B5-2]: Short-term corticosteroids or megestrol acetate (physician-prescribed). Note: megestrol — DVT risk; monitor in Indian patients with higher thrombosis predisposition. | 🏋 EXERCISE [B4-1/B4-2]: Aerobic + resistance training recommended. Yoga as adjunct for Indian patients (evidence for fatigue, QoL, cortisol reduction). Lymphedema: progressive resistance IS SAFE. | ❌ BEWARE: High-dose supplement marketing targeting Indian cancer patients (social media/WhatsApp) — vitamin megadoses, 'cancer-curing' supplements, unproven herbal products — not recommended without oncologist approval [ESPEN B2-4].
Diet_Chart_Indian_Meal_Plan: 🌅 Breakfast: Smooth ragi/oats porridge (full-fat milk + 2 tbsp milk powder + ground flaxseed 1 tsp) + pureed banana + 250 ml ONS — all soft/blended; cool to room temp; avoid acidic/spicy || 🕙 Mid-Morning: Plain khakhra/dry toast + saunf-adrak tea; coconut water sips; room-temp bland foods only; avoid sweet/fatty foods || 🍽 Lunch: 2 ragi roti + palak paneer (80g paneer, minimal oil) + cucumber raita + salad | Ragi + paneer = calcium powerhouse for AI patients || 🕓 Snack: Smooth shrikhand (strained curd + minimal sugar) / banana smoothie (dahi + banana) / coconut milk pudding; AVOID: imli/lemon/spice/rough foods; baking soda + salt gurgle before eating || 🌙 Dinner: 2 bajra/jowar roti + arhar dal + lauki (bottle gourd) sabzi + dahi | Bajra: magnesium + phosphorus; lauki: easily digestible || 🌛 Bedtime: Warm milk + 1 tsp ashwagandha powder (if not on chemo; consult oncologist) + pinch nutmeg | Adaptogen for stress + sleep || ✅ ANOREXIA: 6–8 small Indian meals/day; eat when hunger is best (usually morning); fortify ALL foods: add ghee/coconut oil/peanut butter/milk powder/extra dal/curd; rasam can stimulate appetite; physician may advise megestrol for advanced disease. || ✅ PERIPHERAL NEUROPATHY (Taxane-related): Omega-3 EPA 2–3g/day protective; B12 check + supplement if deficient; B6 at RDA only (NOT high-dose); include fortified foods; walking/balance exercises. || 🌾 MILLETS RECOMMENDATION (ICMR-NIN 2020): Include ragi (calcium), bajra (iron), jowar (fibre), foxtail/kodo/little millet (low GI) — replace 50% white rice/wheat with millets for better glycaemic control and micronutrients. || Regional: Include fish curry (omega-3) 2–3x/week for NV patients; prefer hand-pounded/red rice over polished white; dal-bhaat-sabzi as base; mustard oil (omega-3 source). || 💰 Low SES: Focus on cost-effective anti-cancer foods — seasonal vegetables, local millets, dals, eggs, sprouts. Government schemes: PM Poshan, NFSA for food access. Minimise food waste. Home-cooked preferred. || ⚠ OBESITY (Obese Class I, Indian cut-off ≥25): Obesity significantly increases BC recurrence risk in Indian women. Post-treatment gradual weight loss (0.5 kg/week max). No energy restriction during active treatment. Mediterranean-Indian hybrid diet: dal-sabzi-millet base + minimal ghee/oil. Walk 45 min/day. || 🔴 TNBC (Indian): Higher prevalence in young Indian women (<40 yrs). Highest metabolic demand. Protein 1.5–2.0 g/kg/day mandatory during chemo. Anti-inflammatory diet: haldi, adrak, omega-3, berries, green tea. Immunotherapy patients: watch for immune-related colitis — low-residue if GI symptoms. || ❌ STRICTLY AVOID [ALL INDIAN BC PATIENTS]: Alcohol, tobacco (paan/gutka), vanaspati/dalda (trans fats), excess ghee in obese patients, maida/refined flour products, packaged namkeen/biscuits, sugar-sweetened drinks (even fruit juice), raw/undercooked meat/eggs during chemo. || 🐟 OMEGA-3 FOR VEGETARIANS: Ground flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) + walnuts (5–7/day) + mustard oil for cooking + algae-based DHA supplement (250–500 mg/day) — essential since no fish intake. || 🏃 YOGA + EXERCISE [ESPEN B4-1/B4-2]: Brisk walk 45 min/day + yoga (reduces cortisol/fatigue, improves QoL in Indian BC survivors) + resistance 2–3x/week. Reduces BC recurrence risk significantly.
